# COULDA

> COULDA is an interactive fictional crypto-culture experience about missed opportunities. It is entertainment, not financial advice.

## Main experience

- /#daily — The COULDA Daily Challenge. Visitors choose BUY or SKIP before revealing a server-defined fictional outcome.
- /#generator — Card Lab for generating a custom fictional regret card.
- /#archive — COULDA stories and challenge archive.
- /#lore — Background and explanation of the COULDA concept.
- /#token — Token information and simulation disclaimers.

## Important facts

- All token names, prices, market caps, investments, and returns shown in challenges are fictional simulations.
- The daily challenge is entertainment only and must not be presented as financial advice.
- When no database is connected, participation is explicitly unverified demo mode and no leaderboard is shown.
- Official X account: https://x.com/COULDAPUMP (@COULDAPUMP).

## Crawling

Public pages and assets may be read by ClaudeBot, Claude-User, and Claude-SearchBot. API routes are excluded.
